title: Insomnia
subtitle: What insomnia is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Strong evidence supports cognitive behavioral therapy as first-line treatment for chronic insomnia. Moderate evidence exists for efficacy of pharmacologic therapies with caution due to side effects. Emerging evidence addresses novel interventions and underlying pathophysiology. Safety considerations are well established.
